scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years.
Applicant must have undergone a training programme on Mussel Culture/Oyster Farming organized by the Fisheries Department, MPEDA, ICAR or any other institute.
Applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy up to ₹25,000 per unit for up to 2 estuarine units (4 m × 4 m) and up to ₹40,000 per unit for up to 2 open‑sea units (6 m × 6 m).
